fields.name: v_DEFAULT_TO_CURR_PP_FLAG
fields.expression:
DECODE(TRUE,

		(ISNULL(INIT_PARAM_PP_END_YEAR) OR IS_SPACES(INIT_PARAM_PP_END_YEAR) OR 
              LENGTH(LTRIM(INIT_PARAM_PP_END_YEAR)) = 0) AND

             (ISNULL(INIT_PARAM_PP_NUM) OR IS_SPACES(INIT_PARAM_PP_NUM) OR
              LENGTH(LTRIM(INIT_PARAM_PP_NUM)) = 0),
                      TRUE,

                  FALSE)

fields.name: v_PP_END_YEAR
fields.expression:
DECODE(TRUE,
                 
				v_DEFAULT_TO_CURR_PP_FLAG = TRUE,
		                     lkp_CURR_PP_END_YEAR,

				v_PAY_PERIOD_PARAM_EXISTS_FLAG = TRUE,
                      		PARAM_PP_END_YEAR
                             )


--IIF(v_PAY_PERIOD_PARAM_EXISTS_FLAG = TRUE,
--                 TO_CHAR(PARAM_PP_END_YEAR),
--                 TO_CHAR(lkp_CURR_PP_END_YEAR))

fields.name: v_PP_NUM
fields.expression:
DECODE(TRUE,
                 
				v_DEFAULT_TO_CURR_PP_FLAG = TRUE,
		                     lkp_CURR_PP_NUM,

				v_PAY_PERIOD_PARAM_EXISTS_FLAG = TRUE,
                      		 PARAM_PP_NUM        
                     )



--IIF(v_PAY_PERIOD_PARAM_EXISTS_FLAG = TRUE,
--        	TO_CHAR(PARAM_PP_NUM),
--	TO_CHAR(lkp_CURR_PP_NUM))

table_attributes.Sql Query:
SELECT 
	MAX(PAY_PERIOD.PP_NUM) PP_NUM , 
	MAX(PAY_PERIOD.PP_END_YEAR) PP_END_YEAR 
FROM
 PAY_PERIOD

fields.name: v_ABORT_FLAG
fields.expression:
DECODE(TRUE,

			NOT IS_NUMBER(INIT_PARAM_PP_END_YEAR) AND DEFAULT_TO_CURR_PP_FLAG = FALSE, 
				TRUE,

			NOT IS_NUMBER(INIT_PARAM_PP_NUM) AND DEFAULT_TO_CURR_PP_FLAG = FALSE, 
				TRUE,

			ISNULL(lkp_DFAS_PSEUDO_SSN), 
				TRUE,

                 FALSE)

fields.name: o_ABORT_MESSAGE
fields.expression:
DECODE(TRUE,

                        v_ABORT_FLAG = TRUE AND NOT IS_NUMBER(INIT_PARAM_PP_END_YEAR),
                                 ABORT('!!!! The value : ' || INIT_PARAM_PP_END_YEAR || ' is not a valid pay period year'),

                        v_ABORT_FLAG = TRUE AND NOT IS_NUMBER(INIT_PARAM_PP_NUM),
                                 ABORT('!!!! The value : ' || INIT_PARAM_PP_NUM || ' is not a valid pay period number'),

                        v_ABORT_FLAG = TRUE AND ISNULL(lkp_DFAS_PSEUDO_SSN),
                                 ABORT('!!!! There were no CDC records found for this pay period: ' || INIT_PARAM_PP_END_YEAR || '-' || LPAD(INIT_PARAM_PP_NUM, 2, '0')),

                         FALSE)

fields.name: o_ALT_1_INST_AC_NO
fields.expression:
LPAD(REPLACECHR(0, TO_CHAR(TO_DECIMAL(ALT_1_ROUTE_ID, 0)), '.', NULL), 8, '0')

||

LPAD(REPLACECHR(0, TO_CHAR(TO_DECIMAL(ALT_1_ROUTE_DIGIT, 0)), '.', NULL), 1, '0')

fields.name: o_ALT_2_INST_ACCT_NO

LPAD(REPLACECHR(0, TO_CHAR(TO_DECIMAL(ALT_2_ROUTE_ID, 0)), '.', NULL), 8, '0')

||

LPAD(REPLACECHR(0, TO_CHAR(TO_DECIMAL(ALT_2_ROUTE_DIGIT, 0)), '.', NULL), 1, '0')

fields.name: o_CPP_LUMPSUM_LVPY
fields.expression:
IIF(NOT ISNULL(CPP_LUMPSUM_LVPY),
		IIF(v_CPP_LUMPSUM_LVPY_EXCEEDS_LIMIT_FLAG = TRUE,
			        TO_DECIMAL( v_CPP_LUMPSUM_LVPY_BEFORE_DEC || '.'  || v_CPP_LUMPSUM_LVPY_AFTER_DEC, 2),
        		ABS(CPP_LUMPSUM_LVPY)),
       0)

fields.name: o_YTD_LSL_PAY
fields.expression:
IIF(NOT ISNULL(YTD_LSL_PAY),
		IIF(v_YTD_LSL_PAY_EXCEEDS_LIMIT_FLAG = TRUE,
		       v_YTD_LSL_LV_PAY_SIGN *
			        TO_DECIMAL( v_YTD_LSL_LV_PAY_BEFORE_DEC || '.'  || v_YTD_LSL_LV_PAY_AFTER_DEC ,2),
        		ABS(YTD_LSL_PAY)),
       0)
